title: Open Materials Generation with Stochastic Interpolants
tldr_zh: 用 stochastic interpolants 统一扩散与流匹配，按自由度调插值，CSP/DNG 超 FlowMM/DiffCSP/MatterGen
tldr_en: Unifies diffusion and flow matching via stochastic interpolants with per-degree-of-freedom tuning, outperforming FlowMM/DiffCSP/MatterGen on CSP and DNG
